//: The ship's air, room by room (docs/gameplay-overhaul/11-atmosphere-and-ventilation.md). Keyed by room (map id) and by connection id, never by tile, so the layout can move doors and portholes without touching a save. Concentrations are percent of a room's air (0 to 100 for all substances together); a room's quantity of a substance is percent x volume / 100. Time is hazard time (the same clock as flooding and fire). Nothing here is used by a story chapter: the campaign's fumes are the legacy fume zones, unchanged.

substances.//: safe: the concentration below which it does no harm; potency: exposure per second per point above safe; decay: share lost per second on its own (0 = only ventilation clears it); vent: how readily it leaves through an opening to the outside; heavy: it sinks (flows down faster, up slower: sink and rise).

rooms.//: volume: how much air (bigger rooms dilute more); level: 0 the weather deck, 1 between decks, 2 the hold (heavy gas sinks down the levels).

kinds.//: How much air a connection passes per second in each state (a share of the concentration difference, times the smaller room's volume; to the outside, a share of the room's gas), which states it can be put in, and how long it takes the captain to change it. A damaged connection leaks 'damagedLeak' more whatever its state, and can't be sealed.

connections.//: Every connection between two rooms must be a real doorway (a map warp between them: checked). 'outside' is the open air, where vented gas goes and never comes back. 'state' is the default (a save stores only the ones changed).

quality.//: A room's air by its index (the exposure a second of it gives: the sum over substances of (percent - safe) x potency, where above safe). Below 1% of anything it is clean; any gas, all of it under its safe level, is hazy.

exposure.//: The captain's lungs (0 to max): what he has breathed, not what the room holds. It rises by the room's index each second (x the difficulty's exposureScale, x the fume hazard option), falls in clean air ('recover', or 'recoverHazy' in air that's hazy but harmless). work and walk: how much longer emergency work and each step take; cough: every N seconds a coughing fit stops him; hurt: every N seconds the captain loses hp, never below 'floor' of his maximum.

fire.//: Opt-in: a fire started with "smoke": true sends smoke into its room (intensity x smokePerIntensity a second). No story fire does.

actions.//mend: Prompt 8: a door or hatch a blast left damaged (it leaks when shut and won't seal) is mended with planks and nails on the repair bar.
